hook: New benchmark compares quantum computers on the same scale.
hooks: New benchmark compares quantum computers on the same scale.
Quantum computers lack a standardized way to compare power.
This test reveals the current limits of quantum hardware.
what_happened: Researchers created a benchmark to compare quantum computer power on the same scale, addressing a previous lack of standardized testing methods.
why_it_matters: It removes the bottleneck of comparing different systems, allowing clear evaluation of hardware for complex problems like logistics and molecular modeling.
the_catch: The text does not specify sample size, specific hardware tested, or conditions, only stating that no such benchmark existed until now.
caption: A new benchmark allows quantum computers to be compared on the same scale, revealing their current limitations. How does this change your view of quantum hardware readiness?
alt_text: A five-slide carousel explaining that a new benchmark now allows quantum computers to be compared on the same scale, revealing their limitations.

es.hook: Un nuevo benchmark compara ordenadores cuánticos a la misma escala
es.what_happened: Un equipo de investigadores creó un benchmark para comparar la potencia de los ordenadores cuánticos a la misma escala, algo que antes no existía porque faltaban métodos de prueba estandarizados
es.why_it_matters: Elimina el obstáculo de comparar sistemas distintos y permite evaluar con claridad el hardware para problemas complejos, como la logística y la modelización molecular
es.the_catch: El texto no especifica el tamaño de la muestra, el hardware concreto que se probó ni las condiciones, solo afirma que hasta ahora no existía ningún benchmark de este tipo
